findings.evidence: Mathlib/Data/Fin/VecNotation.lean:151 `@[simp] Fin.snoc_vecEmpty`, :167 `@[simp] Fin.snoc_vecCons`, :285 `@[simp] cons_val_fin_one`; Mathlib/Tactic/Simproc/VecPerm.lean:85 `simproc_decl vecPerm (_ ∘ (_ : Fin _ → Fin _))` with the documented example `![a,b,c] ∘ Equiv.swap 0 1 = ![b,a,c]`.
findings.fix: Replace the `rfl` closers with the named lemmas: `Fin.snoc_vecCons`/`Fin.snoc_vecEmpty` for the snoc goals, `Matrix.cons_val_fin_one` plus `Subsingleton.elim i 0` for `multipoleS_fin_one`, and `simp [vecPerm]` (or `Function.comp` + `Matrix.cons_val_*`) for the `Fin.rev` goals; state the tuple identity as an explicit `have ... := by simp [...]` instead of relying on `congr 1`'s output shape.
findings.issue: `congr 1 <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl` closes `Fin.snoc ![z] x = ![z, x]` by reducing `Fin.snoc`'s `dite`/`cast` on numerals; same pattern at Quadrupole.lean:131 (`![y,w] ∘ Fin.rev = ![w,y]`), Operator.lean:78 (`![x 0] = x`) and the trailing bare `rfl` at Operator.lean:91 (`(![y] ∘ Fin.rev) 0 = y`). Both the `congr 1` goal shape and the defeq are undocumented and break on any change to those definitions.

findings.evidence: Multipole.lean:148-152; the new List file already exists for exactly this kind of index-telescoping fact (List/Basic.lean:33 `prod_ofFn_mul_mul_inv`), and `List.prod_inv_reverse` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/BigOperators/Group/List/Basic.lean:312) gives the lemma in two lines.
findings.fix: Add the general lemma to the new `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/Algebra/BigOperators/Group/List/Basic.lean` next to `prod_ofFn_mul_mul_inv`, e.g. `(List.ofFn fun i => (f i.rev)⁻¹).prod = ((List.ofFn f).prod)⁻¹` for `f : Fin n → G`, and make `multipoleS_reverse` a one-line application of it.
findings.issue: `multipoleS_reverse`'s `h` is an eight-lemma positional chain (`List.ofFn_eq_map` applied twice at different positions, `← List.map_reverse`, `List.finRange_reverse`, `List.map_map`) finished by a catch-all `simp`; the reusable fact it hides — the inverse/star of a `List.ofFn` product equals the product reindexed by `Fin.rev` — is general group algebra.

findings.evidence: Multipole.lean:129 versus Multipole.lean:180-181, where `simp only [..., Unitary.star_eq_inv, _root_.mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left]` performs the same cancellation robustly; `Unitary.star_eq_inv` is upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Star/Unitary.lean:116.
findings.fix: Use the stable normalising set the same file already uses in `key`: `simp only [Unitary.star_eq_inv, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left]` (unitaryGroup is a group, so this closes the cancellation without positional rewrites).
findings.issue: `rw [← mul_assoc, mul_assoc (U x₀), ← mul_assoc (star (U z)), Unitary.star_mul_self, one_mul]` reassociates by explicit position, so it depends on the exact parenthesisation left by the preceding `simp only [List.ofFn_succ, ..., List.prod_cons]`.

summary: Four proofs close tuple-reindexing goals by bare `rfl` after `congr 1`, relying on reduction of `Fin.snoc`/`Fin.rev`/`vecCons` rather than the existing named lemmas; two further proofs use positional rewrite chains where a reusable lemma or a stable simp set is available.
